# Code of Conduct

## Our standards

We want this project to be a welcoming and constructive space. Participants are expected to:

-   Be respectful and considerate.
-   Give and receive feedback professionally.
-   Focus on what is best for the project and its users.
-   Respect different viewpoints and experiences.

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, and disruptive behavior are not acceptable.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior privately to the repository maintainer, [@alexiszamanidis](https://github.com/alexiszamanidis). Reports will be reviewed and handled as confidentially as possible.
